data.completion_memo: Implemented shared native process and authenticated local-IPC primitives and wired them into bootstrap verification launch, capability-host process execution, plugin processes, and trusted-core worker supervision. Added monotonic deadlines, canonical executable identity with stable object/hash revalidation, authenticated bounded local channels using Windows named pipes or Unix-domain sockets, peer credential binding, random nonces, generation fencing, sanitized exact-executable spawning, cleared environments, retained exact group/job handles, descendant enumeration, cooperative then forced cleanup, bounded waits, cleanup evidence, and detached-helper separation. The final task-end audit corrected duplicate-generation ordering, pre-spawn containment validation, post-spawn executable revalidation, retained group/job ownership, detached-helper isolation, authenticated cooperative bootstrap shutdown, stable object identity hashing, and added a negative IPC nonce test. Verification passed with warnings denied across aworkit-process, capability-host, trusted-core, and bootstrap-helper; the focused process suite has 7 passing tests; git diff --check is clean.
data.description: Implement the shared process and local-IPC ports on Windows, macOS, and Linux: authenticated peer/process/executable identity, named-pipe or Unix-channel primitives, sanitized spawning, exact process handles, Job Object or process-group/pidfd lifecycle, descendant enumeration, cooperative and forced cleanup, monotonic deadlines, detached-helper survival, and verification-only generation launch.
data.title: M12.2 — Implement native process, IPC, identity, and cleanup adapters
